tweets.text:
Colorado Legislative Session just opened today and we’re already off to the races with insanity. Check it out below. 

Proud progressive & socialist, Senator Julie Gonzales has introduced a bill titled Rights Violation in Immigration Enforcement Remedy. It raises a lot of questions around the Supremacy Clause but more importantly….

Colorado SB26-005 quietly creates a new civil lawsuit tied to immigration enforcement.

Because it applies to “any person participating” in civil immigration enforcement, it raises a real question:

👉 Could a private citizen who calls ICE be sued if someone is injured during enforcement? The bill doesn’t clearly exclude private individuals or protect good-faith reporting.

That ambiguity is concerning and raises a lot of constitutional questions. Help spread the word.
